title: Harrington denies Brent Friedman's account
place_text: Walnut Creek, California and Washington DC

tellings.quote: lower level. Uh so that's all a lie. And then I told him that I'd been locked away for a month and I'd seen people from another planet. It's just total BS.

related.note: Harrington himself tells about the same claimed 1981 conversation and denies it: he says he never said he saw aliens or was locked away.

plain: John Harrington, who says he served as US Secretary of Energy, talks about a story told by a man named Brent Friedman, set around 1981 in Walnut Creek, California and Washington. Friedman's version, as Harrington describes it, has Harrington saying he had been locked away for a month and had seen people from another planet. Harrington says that this is all a lie and "total BS," even though elsewhere he is quoted saying aliens are real.
